mike: Heads-up — eu-west2 GPU attach errors ~00:42 caused by NVMe write latency p95 ~1150ms on ephemeral drives. Seen during nightly tempfile sweep + janitor overlap. Attach queue spiked, ~30 pods stuck.

mike: logs: `journalctl -u ephemeral-cleaner --since "00:30" | tail -n 40`

infra-bot: CLEANER START gnode-57 sweep files=142k rate=650/s write_latency_p95=1150ms
infra-bot: SMART gnode-57-disk1 Reallocated_Sector_Ct=130 temp=48C

emma: Oof. Is it one bad drive or systemic? Any controller errors? :thinking_face:

mike: SMART spike on gnode-57 only (24 -> 130 in last 12h). But other hosts in the same rack show high write latency without SMART increases.

raj: Likely congestion: janitor + tempfile sweep + nightly metadata flush. Cleaner rate 650/s is aggressive during attach window. Can we throttle and jitter start times?

emma: Agree. Quick mitigation: throttle cleaner to 200/s for the next window and add jitter 60-180s. Config change: `CLEANER_RATE=200` `CLEANER_JITTER=120s`

mike: Doing a canary now on eu-west2 gnode-57..66 (10 nodes). If p95 falls below ~200ms we'll roll cluster-wide. Will watch attach queue.

infra-bot: deploy status: cleaner-config canary started on gnode-57..66 (10 nodes) — rollout id=rc-2026-03-21-01

raj: Also recommend enabling prefix/KV cache warmup for attach-heavy jobs to reduce write amplification. Long-term: stagger janitor windows per rack.

mike: Noted. Plan B if canary fails: pause cleaner, mark affected drives read-only, reprovision and drain GPUs. For now monitoring 30m. Ping me if backlog reduces or if any new SMART alerts. :thumbsup:

emma: Thanks — will watch metrics and update on escalation channel.

mike: Update in 10m with p95 numbers.
